pitch:
ILLUSTRUS (Oradea) makes the website your funded project needs, in 10 days, with the delivery documents your reimbursement file asks for.

What you get for 800 EUR (excl. VAT), fixed: a 5-page website for your business (home, services/products, about, the funding page in the format your programme requires, contact); texts written by me from a 45-minute phone interview with you (you do not have to write anything); photos: 10 photos you take with your phone from my list, or licensed images; your domain and 12 months of hosting included; the technical delivery documents: acceptance report with the website address, dated screenshots, and an invoice whose description matches your contract. Your consultant and you remain responsible for the grant file itself; I give you the proof of delivery they ask me for.

How it works: 50% at signing, 50% when the site is online and matches the written list of pages; if you do not reply to a review within 5 working days, that step counts as accepted. The site is yours (domain in your name). After the first year, optional maintenance 30 EUR/month (updates, backup, small changes), or you take it elsewhere.

Who I am: owner of ILLUSTRUS, itself a LEADER grant start-up from Bihor, so I have filled in the same reports you will; database developer by day, web and automation by training. One person, 10–12 hours a week: I take one site at a time, delivered in 10 days.

What it is not: not a custom-designed brand site (it is a clean template), not SEO campaigns, not a promise of customers from Google.
